newsitem.title: USA: CBOT-LIFFE amend linkage to include Euro bonds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT-LIFFE amend linkage to include Euro bonds.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) and the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) have amended their linkage agreement to include trading long-term Euro debt products, the exchanges said in a joint statement.
The CBOT will trade Euro-denominated government bonds in its open outcry pits through its linkage with LIFFE when the single European currency is introduced in 1999.
"This milestone is an important part of our exchange's strategy to aggressively compete for international trading opportunities," CBOT chairman Pat Arbor said in the statement.
U.S. Treasury bond and German government bond futures and options will be available for pit trading at LIFFE and CBOT respectively during U.S. and European business hours starting on May 9, 1997.

"This is a further enhancement of the historic and unique link between LIFFE and CBOT," LIFFE chairman Jack Wigglesworth said in the statement. -Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com
